description.en: The ID of the AD office network.

description.zh: 开启或者关闭单点登录SSO。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable or disable single sign-on (SSO). Valid values:
- true: enables SSO
- false: disables SSO.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service.

title.zh: 设置AD办公网络的单点登录SSO开关状态
title.en: Set SSO status for an AD office network

descriptions.zh: 作用与接口[SetOfficeSiteSsoStatus](~~SetOfficeSiteSsoStatus~~)相同，建议使用`SetOfficeSiteSsoStatus`接口。
descriptions.en: This operation has the same effect as [SetOfficeSiteSsoStatus](~~SetOfficeSiteSsoStatus~~). Use the SetOfficeSiteSsoStatus operation instead.
